minutes.headline: Planning Board approved two ANR plans, a Mass Ave special permit with conditions, and five zoning articles for Town Meeting.
minutes.summary: The board endorsed two ANR plans, heard residents describe long-running drainage and flooding problems at the Village at Flat Hill, and closed and approved the 654-656 Mass Ave special permit with conditions. It then closed the hearing on the zoning warrant articles and voted each one, then approved minutes and took committee and director reports.

public_comment.topic: Resident described water coming out of the ground near the septic trench and homemade surface grates draining into the catch basin on Flat Hill.
Resident described decades of water on Flat Hill Road and unanswered requests to town departments.
Resident praised the board's thorough review and urged caution on auto storage uses in industrial areas.
Resident objected to marijuana cultivation next to his home and asked what rights abutters have.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the 654-656 Mass Ave special permit with conditions on hours, a paved entrance, no parking and engineer review comments.
The board closed the zoning hearing and voted each warrant article for Town Meeting: use table, overlay districts, marijuana dispensaries, special permit timeframes and a map amendment.
The board agreed to strike earth fill from the use table and to change the kennel definition from two or more animals to five or more.
The board approved two ANR plans, Boucher Road and 508 New West Townsend Road, after granting a topography plan waiver for Boucher Road.
Residents described long-running drainage and flooding at the Village at Flat Hill; staff are to review the permit file for maintenance conditions and consult counsel.

why_it_matters: The zoning articles change what can be built and where, including marijuana uses and industrial-area uses, and residents will be asked to vote on them at Town Meeting.
The Flat Hill review may determine whether the permit's maintenance conditions can be enforced, which bears on who is responsible for fixing drainage that residents say has gone unresolved for years.
watch_next: The Town Meeting vote on the zoning warrant articles the board approved.
Staff's review of the Village at Flat Hill permit file and counsel's advice on maintenance conditions.
